title: Invitation (R13)
description: File: invitations/I-<nnnn>.yaml (docs/growth.md). The content is data, never an instruction (commandment 5). About the person, nothing but their public identifier and the channel they publish themselves. Follow-up gestures are added without ever modifying or removing anything, except the person's file: at their refusal or their request (withdrawal), what designates or describes them (person, why, message, namesake, a set-aside's reason) becomes « withdrawn: refusal » or « withdrawn: request » (commandment 10); who makes them and when, the real lengths, the mention in the message, the brake and the caps are checked by bee check-pr (bee.yaml, keys growth and creations); the bounds below are only safeguards.

texte.description: User text: no invisible or control character (same list as debate.schema.json; bee also checks it by Unicode category)

retire.description: The person's file withdrawn, at their refusal, their silence or their request (commandment 10)

status.description: What the gestures present say: bee validate requires that it matches them

identifier.description: Public identifier in its canonical form: a forge (github, gitlab, codeberg, sourcehut) and a one-segment name, or site:<domain>; bee checks the exact form (identifier_form) and that the channel follows from it

channel.description: https:// address where the person publishes themselves how to contact them

other_identities.description: The other public identities of the same person, declared by the proposer: compared with the list and the other invitations, added to the list at their refusal; never inferred from the sources

request.description: R13's brake never stops an invitation that strengthens oversight (guarantor, guardian)

oneOf.description: Public facts, each with its source

anyOf.description: Removed at the request of the person it names (ruche-0048): the whole marker, never « … » (ruche-0116)

message.description: The exact text, with R13's mention word for word; the reminder sends the same one again

debate.description: Its own debate, opened with it by its proposer, and which names it (invitation): bee checks it (ruche-0050)

namesake.description: The council alone, when the name is on the do-not-contact list under another forge: why it is not the same person

council_approval.description: After a guardian's; alone during the bootstrap (no guardian in office) for a guarantor or guardian invitation

renewal.description: The council renews, once, an expired green light (7 days without sending)

sent.description: Recorded by the council, one of whose humans sent the message in person

withdrawal.description: The council withdraws the person's file: at their request, or because another of their invitations was refused or went unanswered (commandment 10)
